correctness.rationale: The morphism nu(0)=01,nu(1)=2,nu(2)=0 has factor digrams {00,01,10,12,20} and seven trigrams {001,010,012,101,120,200,201}; 01 uniquely synchronizes the left image boundary. Frougny–Masakova–Pelantova Theorem 3.9 plus affine complexity 2n+1 (under the corrigendum-compatible t=(1,0,1)) ensures every left-special factor is a prefix; recursive desubstitution identifies the sole right-special prefixes u_j. Each extension graph has exactly four pairs among 3·2 possible and transforms bijectively by nu and the last-letter permutation. Thus the four absent digrams and two missing bilateral contexts for each j exhaust MAWs. Eight independently checked graphs from the 21st substitution iterate agree; finite prefixes cannot prove infinite synchronization.
residual_risks: Finite 8 graph checks do not establish infinitely many synchronized levels.
